title: Spec: CI/CD強化
summary: 品質保証自動化の仕様。R1: pre-commit hook (YAML frontmatter 検証, JSON syntax 検証, TODO marker 検出禁止, UTF-8 強制)。R2: GitHub Actions validate.yml (quick-validate-skill.py, JSON schema validation, script --help 動作確認, evaluate-gate.py dry-run, risk-heatmap.py SVG 生成)。R3: golden-diff.yml (golden input/output diff 可視化, schema 変更時の breaking change 警告)。R4: Release workflow (tag 作成時に artifact zip 生成)。
